description: This file defines a C# class 'Cookies' that provides methods for managing cookies through JavaScript interop in a Blazor application. It encapsulates functionality to delete and retrieve cookies via the IJSRuntime interface.

classes.name: Cookies
classes.description: A class that interacts with JavaScript to manage cookies asynchronously within a Blazor application.

methods.name: DeleteCookie
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a cookie by name via JavaScript interop.

methods.name: GetCookie
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the value of a cookie by name via JavaScript interop.
